watches.name: The New Shumate Diver 16120 - Black DLC
watches.description: Back by insatiable demand, the brand new Shumate is back in 7 new colors and 3 band options. The Shumate dive watch was requested by, and designed for, the U.S. Special Forces Green Berets. The collection is named for Sergeant Major Walter L. Shumate, a legend in the Special Forces community and the man who was instrumental in the creation of the Special Forces Underwater Operations School. The forged, surgical-grade stainless steel case is 500 meters/1500 feet water-resistant. We use 50 layers of SuperLuminova for outstanding viewing in darkness. We include a top of the line, custom dive bracelet AND an Italian leather strap (with tools to swap them). The Shumate is a top-shelf, extremely refined yet rugged dive watch that looks & feels fantastic in any setting and no matter what you’re wearing – a business suit or a wetsuit. Check the specs below for all the awesome details. watches.name: Nous Defions Shumate Dive Watch: Steel Bracelet, Leather Strap & Canvas Strap
watches.description: NFW is excited & honored to be producing these watches to benefit the Green Beret Foundation, providing direct and continuous support to the Green Beret Community and its families. This watch features the Special Forces insignia known as the "Nous Defions," showing the skull, arrows & dagger, as used by today's Special Forces. Although the exact origins of the symbol are shrouded in mystery, this insignia can be traced to the infamous Mott Lake counter-terrorist training facility near Fort Bragg, NC. It also has roots dating back to WWII French resistance fighters. "Nous Defions" roughly translates to "We Defy." Each purchase of this model will generate a $45 contribution to Green Beret Foundation. The model is part of our Shumate Collection, named for SF legend SGM Walter Shumate. The watch is forged from surgical-grade stainless steel, and is 300 Meters Water-Resistant. It comes on our awesome Shumate Diver's Bracelet (with ratcheting size adjustment in the clasp), and with two straps (a fine Italian leather strap, AND an OD green canvas strap), as well as a pair of hex drivers for swapping bands & another pair for sizing the bracelet links to your wrist. It utilizes SuperLuminova, the luminescent material used on the finest watches in the world. The movement features a whopping 10-year continuous-run battery life. JUST THE FACTS Case: 44mm, Forged 316L Stainless Steel Water Resistance: 300 Meters / 1000 Feet Movement: Citizen Precision Quartz, with 10-year Battery Life Crystal: Sapphire, with anti-reflective coating on underside Lume: C3 Green SuperLuminova Dial: Black with the Nous Defions Insignia DIRTY DETAILS Movement: Citizen Precision Quartz, 10-Year Battery Life Straps: Stainless Steel Bracelet with Dive Clasp, Black Italian Leather with reinforcing screws, AND an OD Green Canvas Strap Strap Attachment: Hex-Head Screwbars, 10 times stronger than standard spring bars Watch Weight: 260 grams / 9.2 oz. (on bracelet) Case Thickness: 15.4 mm Lug Width: 24mm Crown: Screw Down, double-gasket Caseback: Screw-in, stainless steel Case Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel, with Black DLC Bezel

watches.name: Shumate Diver Brushed Stainlesss Steel Bracelet
watches.description: This is one of the finest watch bracelets on the market. We designed and made it specifically for our Shumate Collection case design. It features fully articulated endpieces that mate perfectly with the watch case's lugs. And, it's easy to install on your watch. The links are a 5-section design that feels extremely comfortable and doesn't pinch or pull hairs. Each link is connected with hex-head screws for an ultra-strong bracelet. Our clasp features a ratchet-adjustment for quick & easy adjustments to tighten or loosen the bracelet (to fit over a wetsuit sleeve, or if your wrist just swells a bit after eating a salty meal on a hot summer night!). The bracelet is fully machined from surgical-grade 316L stainless steel, and brushed to a beautiful finish. Lastly, it comes with a pair of hex drivers if you need to remove a few links to get the perfect fit on your wrist. It installs easily on any of our Shumate or AutoPilot watches.

watches.name: Shumate Black DLC Watch Bracelet
watches.description: This is one of the finest watch bracelets on the market. We designed and made it specifically for our Shumate Collection case design. It features fully articulated endpieces that mate perfectly with the watch case's lugs. The links are a 5-section design that feels extremely comfortable and doesn't pinch or pull hairs. Each link is connected with hex-head screws for an ultra-strong bracelet. Our clasp features a ratchet-adjustment for quick & easy adjustments to tighten or loosen the bracelet (to fit over a wetsuit sleeve, or if your wrist just swells a bit after eating a salty meal on a hot summer night!). The bracelet is fully machined from 316L stainless steel, and coated with a durable, matte-black DLC coating. Lastly, it comes with a pair of hex drivers if you need to remove a few links to get the perfect fit on your wrist. It installs easily on any of our Shumate or AutoPilot watches.

watches.name: Valor 14217 ST
watches.description: Valor 14217 ST features a 42mm case, forged from the finest 316L surgical-grade stainless steel, in a brushed finish, inset with a thick sapphire crystal and a sapphire exhibition caseback to show off the NFW-signed Caliber 9015 Automatic movement. The dial is gray camo pattern. C3 SuperLuminova is used on the dial markers & hands for outstanding viewing in darkness. We also supply the tools needed to change bands and remove bracelet links. watches.name: THE FLY
watches.description: This is the watch that NFW supplies to the NFL refs, who use it as their official timing device for NFL games. The Fly’s extreme comfort and light weight make it an outstanding watch for runners, Obstacle Course Racers, or officials in any sport. The Fly is built with the most useful features: Time/Date with Dual Time Zone Toggle (with Easy-Set Forward/Reverse) Chronograph/Stopwatch (with lap function) Countdown Timer that auto-resets after each interval to the amount you’ve set Daily Alarm BBS (Blue Backlight System) 100 Meters Water-Resistance We focused on not making The Fly overly complicated with features you’d hardly ever use. If you’re looking for a great sports watch, that’s lightweight, comfy and not overly bulky (and doesn’t need to be continually recharged!), then look no further. The Fly has landed!
